title: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Agents: Learning to Learn from Experience
abstract: arXiv:2603.18272v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced the development of general-purpose agents, robust generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. Two common approaches are supervised fine-tuning and training-free memory-augmented generation using retrieved experience; yet both have limitations: fine-tuning often fails to extrapolate to new tasks, while experience retrieval often underperforms compared to supervised baselines. In this work, we combine these approaches and study how retrieval-augmented LLM agents can learn to use retrieved trajectories in-context. First, we establish a strong LoRA fine-tuning baseline that outperforms several state-of-the-art agent training pipelines. Second, we analyze key design choices for experience retrieval, including storage, querying, and trajectory selection. translated_title: 检索增强的大语言模型智能体：学会从经验中学习
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）推动了通用智能体的发展，但对未见任务的鲁棒泛化仍然具有挑战性。两种常见方法是监督微调和使用检索经验的无训练记忆增强生成；然而两者都存在局限：微调往往难以外推到新任务，而经验检索的表现通常不如监督基线。在这项工作中，我们将这两种方法结合起来，研究检索增强的LLM智能体如何学会在上下文中使用检索到的轨迹。首先，我们建立了一个强大的LoRA微调基线，其性能优于多个最先进的智能体训练流程。其次，我们分析了经验检索的关键设计选择，包括存储、查询和轨迹选择。然后，我们将经验检索直接集成到微调过程中，发现这显著提升了泛化能力。
tldr: 该论文将经验检索直接融入LoRA微调过程，让检索增强的LLM智能体学会在上下文中利用检索到的轨迹，从而显著提升对未见任务的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates experience retrieval directly into the LoRA fine-tuning process, enabling retrieval-augmented LLM agents to learn to use retrieved trajectories in-context, which substantially improves generalization to unseen tasks.
